subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should rapid media bursts on channels without native grouping metadata be supported as LINE-specific opt-in batching, designed as a shared channel SDK contract, or intentionally left unsupported?
rationale: The remaining work adds delayed webhook semantics, a new config/default surface, and heuristic grouping for a channel without a reliable native album id, so automation should not choose the product boundary or defaults.

options.title: LINE opt-in batching
options.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin config key and batch same-account, same-conversation, same-sender downloadable media with documented latency and reply-token tradeoffs.

options.title: Shared channel contract
options.body: Design a media-aware channel SDK/core contract first, accepting broader architecture and compatibility review before changing LINE behavior.

options.title: Keep unsupported
options.body: Keep Telegram's native media-group handling only and document that channels without reliable grouping metadata dispatch media events individually.

recommendation.title: LINE opt-in batching
recommendation.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin config key and batch same-account, same-conversation, same-sender downloadable media with documented latency and reply-token tradeoffs.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses LINE config, channel semantics, and plugin-boundary policy where recent path history shows repeated ownership.
